metadata.case_name: KONG LIN FAT JOHNNY v. THE INCORPORATED OWNERS OF CHANG PAO CHING BUILDING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Proprietor of his own travel agency business (sales director previously employed by Y2 Holidays Travel Limited)

injuries.description: Neck injury (minor sprain of the right trapezius muscle)
source: I find that the plaintiff’s his neck injury was directly caused by the sudden stop of the Lift.
it was found that the plaintiff’s neck was "soft with full range of movement". There was mild tenderness over the right trapezius muscle.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: Right ankle / right heel contusion (twisted right ankle and contusion of the right heel)
source: He twisted his right ankle as a result of the sudden stop of the Lift.
the contusion of the right heel was due to his kicking on the lift door.
Dr Ho opined that there was a minor sprain of the right trapezius muscle which was caused by the sudden stop of the lift. The contusion of the right heel was due to his kicking on the lift door.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot

source: I accept the expert opinion of Dr Benjamin Lai and Dr Wong Chung Kwong that the plaintiff’s clinical features did not meet the full diagnostic criteria of PTSD. I find that the plaintiff actually suffered from Adjustment Disorder and the Accident is the direct cause of the plaintiff’s psychiatric injury of Adjustment Disorder.
In conclusion, the plaintiff had suffered from Adjustment Disorder from April 2008 to March 2009.

manifestations.description: Mild tenderness over the right trapezius muscle
Right ankle pain / twisted right ankle
Fear and phobia about travelling by lift (needed someone to accompany him when taking lifts)
Low mood, loss of confidence and feeling worthless
Fleeting suicidal thought and attempted suicide by overdose (6 November 2008)
Poor concentration and poor memory affecting work performance
Anger, irritability and quarrels with wife
Cessation of sporting activities (football, running, table tennis, swimming)

treatments_received.treatment: Accident & Emergency treatment and discharge same day
source: After 20 minutes, the plaintiff was helped out of the lift car of the Lift by a fireman and was then sent to the Accident and Emergency Department of Ruttonjee & Tang Shiu Kin Hospital (“RTSKH”) by an ambulance.

At about 2:40 pm on the same day, the plaintiff reached the A&E Department of RTSKH for treatment. At about 4:00 pm on the same day, the plaintiff was discharged from RTSKH and he returned to his office on foot.
He was given tubigrip for his right ankle.

treatments_received.treatment: Referral to psychiatric clinic at Prince of Wales Hospital and psychiatric consultations
source: On about 28 March 2008, the plaintiff attended RTSKH again for consultation. ... The plaintiff was then referred to Prince of Wales Hospital (“PWH”) for psychiatric treatment.
The plaintiff’s first psychiatric consultation was on 3 November 2008 at PWH.
He was prescribed zoloft by the doctor.
The plaintiff was prescribed antidepressants, such as sertraline (zoloft), since his psychiatric consultation on 3 November 2008.

treatments_received.treatment: Admission to Acute Integrated Unit for treatment after suicide attempt and discharge against medical advice
source: On about 6 November 2008, the plaintiff was admitted to Acute Integrated Unit because of his suicide attempt by drug overdose of sertraline. He was rescued and treated. He was discharged from hospital on 7 November 2008 against medical advice.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Cessation of football, running, table tennis and swimming after the Accident due to pain and psychiatric symptoms.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Fear and phobia about travelling by lift; needed someone to accompany him when taking lifts shortly after the Accident.
Poor concentration and poor memory affecting ability to organise work and make arrangements for clients.
Increased quarrels with his wife and strained family relations after the Accident.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Complained of decreased sex drive after the Accident.
Low self-esteem, loss of confidence and social impact from Adjustment Disorder.
Temporary neck injury and right ankle / right heel contusion causing pain and requiring initial treatment.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Physical injury and psychiatric injury of adjustment disorder lasting about 2 years
